segment (SR-PKG-INDEX decision 3). `fux pack` writes it (W-302); the
THE MANIFEST IS NOT COVERED BY THE SEGMENT DIGEST, because it carries the
digest and a file cannot hold its own hash. So the reader trusts none of its
numbers: `digest` is checked against the digest computed over the shards and
`identifiers.toml`, and the header is read off the shards themselves.
(SR-PKG-INDEX decision 4 -- a deviation from W-299's step 2, flagged for

fux_version.doc: the fux version that packed the segment

index_header.doc: the shards' header line, parsed: `_format`, `analyzer`, `tf_fields`, and `identifiers` when rules exist

content.doc: the DOCS package the index describes -- `npm` and/or `pypi` (at least one) and `version`; see the `content` shape

docs.doc: the number of document records across the shards

digest.doc: `sha256:<hex>` over `[plugins.index] segment`, in the RECORD-line form -- what the pin holds
